name: Savings calculator updates estimated savings when selecting extended vacation duration
description: When a user selects the 90 days extended vacation duration in the dead-rent savings calculator, the estimated savings and comparative bars recalculate dynamically with the 15% discount.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the dead-rent savings calculator section
Click the button to set 90 days vacation duration
Verify the estimated savings panel displays the active 15% extended break discount badge and the recalculated savings amount
